LESSON: COLOURING MAKING

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.4: Colouring MAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Colouring MAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. display ability to use colour media freely for enjoyment
2. appreciate and talk about their work work photos of their coloured drawings their displayed work 83 computer drawing tools to colour some generated shapes Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. display ability to use colour media freely for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display ability to use colour media freely for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate and talk about their work work photos of their coloured drawings their displayed work 83 computer drawing tools to colour some generated shapes Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate and talk about their work work photos of their coloured drawings their displayed work 83 computer drawing tools to colour some generated shapes Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
